title: Adjournment Motion on strengthening Singapore's equities market
what_it_is: An Adjournment Motion debate in which Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis and Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim set out proposals for Singapore's equities market and Minister Chee Hong Tat responds on the Government's review and measures.
why_it_matters: The Minister says the measures aim to make the market more competitive and to increase investor participation, and that MAS will take steps to strengthen investor confidence and enhance investor protection mechanisms, especially for retail investors. He also reports that average daily traded value on SGX grew more than 20% year-on-year to almost $1.8 billion in November 2025, IPO activity raised more than $2.4 billion last year, and SGX total market value crossed $1 trillion.

key_points.point: The Deputy Leader of the House moved that Parliament adjourn.
key_points.speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
key_points.quote: I beg to move, "That Parliament do now adjourn."

key_points.point: Mr Chua declared that he is an equities analyst working in a financial institution in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: I am an equities analyst working in a financial institution in Singapore.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said he rose to speak on the future of Singapore's equities market.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: I rise today to speak on an issue that is very close to my heart: the future of Singapore's equities market

key_points.point: Mr Chua said the $5 billion Equity Market Development Programme funding demonstrates genuine commitment.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: the $5 billion Equity Market Development Programme (EQDP) funding demonstrates genuine commitment

key_points.point: Mr Chua said the review group's current recommendations may be necessary but not sufficient to drive permanent change.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: the current recommendations by the review group may be necessary but not sufficient to truly drive permanent change.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said 61% of SGX companies generated return on equity below 8% as of end January 2026, compared with 44% in Japan and 24% in Korea.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: as of end January 2026, 61% of Singapore Exchange (SGX) companies generated return on equity below 8%, compared to 44% in Japan and 24% in Korea.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said only 14 SGX-listed companies have daily trading volume above US$20 million.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: Only 14 SGX-listed companies have daily trading volume above US$20 million.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said 69% of Singapore-listed companies have shrunk in market capitalisation over the past decade.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: 69% of Singapore-listed companies have shrunk in market capitalisation over the past decade.

key_points.point: Mr Chua called for mandatory value-up disclosure requirements to be instituted immediately.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: We must institute mandatory value-up disclosure requirements immediately.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said all listed companies should conduct formal board level assessments of capital costs, profitability and market valuation.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: all listed companies should conduct formal board level assessments of capital costs, profitability and market valuation.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said companies must disclose quantified ROE and ROIC targets and specific plans with annual progress reporting.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: Companies must then disclose quantified ROE and ROIC targets across medium- to long-term time horizons and spell out specific plans with annual progress reporting.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said SGX rules have required disclosure of directors' and CEOs' remuneration since January 2023.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: SGX rules require disclosure of directors and chief executive officers' remuneration since January 2023.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said only 68% of companies disclosed exact remuneration by December 2024.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: only 68% of companies disclose exact remuneration by December 2024.

key_points.point: Mr Chua welcomed the MAS announcement in May 2025 that a committee is reviewing the Code of Corporate Governance.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: I welcome the MAS announcement in May 2025 that a committee is reviewing the Code of Corporate Governance.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said reducing regulatory fiction is pro-enterprise but raises concerns about investor protection.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: While reducing regulatory fiction is pro-enterprise, it raises concerns about investor protection.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said MAS imposed a $12.6 million civil penalty in the Noble Group case.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: MAS imposed a $12.6 million civil penalty.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said Section 199 of the Securities and Futures Act sets a high bar for false or misleading statements.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: Section 199 of the Securities and Futures Act requires not merely that a material statement or information was false or misleading, but that the wrongdoer either does not care whether it was true or false or knows or ought reasonably to have known that the statement of information is false or misleading in a material way.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said the work of MAS and the Equities Market Review Group is a positive step forward.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: the work of the MAS and Equities Market Review Group are a positive step forward.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim offered a third pillar premised on macro-financial reform to enrich the capital raising life cycle.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: offer a third pillar premised on macros-financial reform: enrich the capital raising life cycle.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said Singapore's stock market capitalisation as a share of national output stood at 117% last year, between India and Malaysia.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: Singapore's stock market capitalisation, as a share of national output, stood at 117% last year, between India and Malaysia.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said returns are distinct from liquidity and the primary role of a stock market is to raise capital.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: Returns are distinct from liquidity and the primary role of any stock market is to raise capital to fund investments, with returns being secondary.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said Singapore's venture capital market was estimated at around $1.2 billion in 2024, a small fraction of more than $4 billion raised in comparable early-stage rounds from the Bay Area or the United Kingdom.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: One estimate places our venture capital market at around $1.2 billion in 2024, a small fraction of the more than $4 billion raised by comparable early-stage rounds from either the Bay Area or the United Kingdom.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim seconded Temasek's recent decision to back away from early stage investing and focus on later stage funding rounds.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: I, therefore, second the recent decision by Temasek to back away from directing exposures to early stage investing and instead focus on later stage, meaning Series B and later funding rounds.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim favoured an even stronger focus on the pre-IPO stage with a clearer mandate to target locally based companies.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: favour an even stronger focus on the pre-IPO stage with a clearer mandate to target locally based companies.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim noted the $1.5 billion Anchor Fund @ 65 and $500 million Growth IPO Fund have been in place since 2022.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: the $1.5 billion Anchor Fund @ 65 and $500 million Growth IPO Fund have been in place since 2022 to support high growth firms with public listings.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said Catalist had only six IPOs last year and four the year prior.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: Last year, there were only six IPOs and it was four the year prior.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said GEMS is presently biased in favour of main board listings rather than Catalist.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: GEMS is presently biased in favour of main board listings rather than Catalist

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said MAS has tabled proposals for streamlining primary and secondary listings.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: MAS has also tabled proposals for streamlining primary and secondary listings.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim suggested granting firms that list continued recognition as SMEs for tax purposes over an interim period.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: granting firms that may choose to list continued recognition as SMEs for tax purposes over an interim period as an additional inducement.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said the favourable tax treatment for family offices under sections 13O and 13U applies only when a minimum allocation is made to qualifying investments.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: the favourable tax treatment for family offices under sections 13O and 13U of the Income Tax Act only applies when a minimum allocation is made to qualifying investments.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said one in two Singaporeans already own stocks and half of the local exchange is held by individuals.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: One in two Singaporeans already own stocks and half of the local exchange is already held by individuals.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said the Central Provident Fund Investment Scheme already allows an opt-in for Singapore-listed shares on the SGX.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: The Central Provident Fund Investment Scheme already allows an opt-in for Singapore-listed shares on the SGX.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said Sweden has demonstrated that bottom-up participation can underpin stock market success.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: Sweden has demonstrated that such bottom-up participation can underpin stock market success.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim said a successful SGX will require attention to the full capital-raising cycle from startup through listing on both the buy and sell side.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
key_points.quote: ultimately, a successful SGX will require we pay attention to the full capital-raising cycle, from startup through listing on both the buy and sell side.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat thanked Mr Louis Chua and Assoc Prof Jamus Lim for their interest and suggestions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: I thank Mr Louis Chua and Assoc Prof Jamus Lim for their interest and suggestions in strengthening Singapore's equities market.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said average daily traded value of securities on SGX grew more than 20% year-on-year to almost $1.8 billion in November 2025.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: The average daily traded value of securities on SGX grew more than 20% year-on-year to almost $1.8 billion in November 2025.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said average daily traded value of securities in 2025 was the highest since 2010.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: The average daily traded value of securities in 2025 was the highest since 2010.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said the number of Singapore-listed stocks with at least $1 million in average daily trading turnover has risen to 100.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: the number of Singapore-listed stocks with at least $1 million in average daily trading turnover has risen to 100.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said IPO activity rebounded last year with more than $2.4 billion in total funds raised, the highest since 2019.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: The IPO activity rebounded significantly last year, with more than $2.4 billion in total funds raised, which is the highest level since 2019.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said the total market value of listed companies on SGX crossed the $1 trillion mark.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: The total market value of listed companies on SGX also crossed the $1 trillion mark.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said the Straits Times Index delivered over 28% total returns last year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: the Straits Times Index (STI) delivered strong returns last year, with over 28% total returns.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said an Equity Market Implementation Committee co-chaired by MAS and SGX has been established.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: we have established an Equity Market Implementation Committee, co-chaired by MAS and SGX.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said $3.95 billion has been allocated across nine asset managers under EQDP.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: we have allocated $3.95 billion across nine asset managers under EQDP to develop our fund management industry and to increase investor participation in our market.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said other initiatives are on track and will be implemented over the course of the year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: Other initiatives are on track and will be implemented over the course of the year as we modernise market infrastructure and launch new market connectivity initiatives.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said more resources will be devoted to public and investor education with partners including the SGX Academy and SIAS.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: We will devote more resources into public and investor education, working with partners, like the SGX Academy and the Securities Investors Association (Singapore)

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said the shift towards a more disclosure-based regime will continue to seek high quality listings and provide adequate and timely information for investors.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: When we shift towards a more disclosure-based regime, with regulation that is more focused and facilitative, we will continue to seek high quality listings and provide adequate and timely information for investors to make their decisions.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said MAS will take steps to strengthen investor confidence and enhance investor protection mechanisms, especially for retail investors.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: MAS will take steps to strengthen investor confidence, such as encouraging transparency and shareholder engagements through initiatives under the Value Unlock Programme, while enhancing investor protection mechanisms, especially for retail investors, such as strengthening their options for recourse against misconduct.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said he takes Mr Louis Chua's point that some requirements may have to be mandatory and the Government is open to looking at these examples.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: I take Mr Louis Chua's point that some requirements may have to be mandatory, and we are certainly open to looking at these examples.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said not everything that can add value needs to be mandated because companies have a commercial interest in increasing market value.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: not everything that can add value to the company needs to be mandated because the companies themselves would have strong commercial interest to want to make sure they can increase their market value.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said MAS and relevant authorities will continue robust investigation, market surveillance and timely enforcement against breaches and market misconduct.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: MAS and the relevant authorities in Singapore will continue to work closely on robust investigation, market surveillance and timely enforcement against breaches of disclosure requirements and market misconduct.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said the SGX-Nasdaq Global Listing Board will be implemented later this year and will enable eligible companies to list on both exchanges with one prospectus.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: The SGX-Nasdaq Global Listing Board, when implemented later this year, will enable eligible companies to simultaneously list on both exchanges with one set of prospectus.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said the strategy is not a silver bullet and there is no magic pill.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: We are not trying to go for a silver bullet that can, on its own, solve all the problems. There is no magic pill.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said the goal is an equities market where companies focus on shareholder value creation, communicate strategies, optimise capital allocation and deliver good shareholder returns.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: Our goal is to build an equities market where companies sharpen their attention on shareholder value creation, communicate their strategies clearly, optimise capital allocation and thus deliver good shareholder returns.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said without good shareholder returns the outcome cannot be achieved.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: if you do not have good shareholder returns, you would not be able to achieve that outcome.

key_points.point: Minister Chee Hong Tat said the Government has laid the foundations and set in motion a comprehensive programme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: We have laid the foundations and set in motion a comprehensive programme.

key_points.point: The Speaker informed Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 1.30 pm.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: I wish to inform hon Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 1.30 pm.

key_points.point: The House adjourned at 6.34 pm.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: Adjourned accordingly at 6.34 pm.

what_happens_next: The Minister said other initiatives are on track and will be implemented over the course of the year, and the SGX-Nasdaq Global Listing Board will be implemented later this year. The Speaker informed Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 1.30 pm, and the House adjourned at 6.34 pm.
not_said: Whether mandatory value-up disclosure requirements will be introduced, and on what timeline.
Whether the Code of Corporate Governance review will result in changes to disclosure rules.
How the remaining EQDP funds beyond the $3.95 billion allocated will be deployed.
Whether GEMS will be rebalanced toward Catalist listings.
Whether family office tax treatment will be refined to require onshore allocations.
Whether the SGX-Nasdaq Global Listing Board will be implemented by a specific date.
Whether the measures will reverse the decline in market capitalisation described in the debate.
Whether retail investor recourse mechanisms will change, and how.
Whether Temasek's focus on later-stage investing will affect domestic venture capital liquidity.
Whether the Government will adopt the proposed SME tax recognition for listed firms.
Whether the proposed tax-free status for employee stock ownerships will be introduced.
Whether the CPF Investment Scheme or the Lifetime Retirement Investment Scheme will be revised to promote local market index ownership.
Whether the $30 million grant under the Value Unlock Programme will be expanded.
Whether MAS will announce a clear timeline for mandatory disclosures.
Whether the review group's recommendations will be implemented in full.
Whether the Government will introduce more robust disclosure obligations under Section 199 of the Securities and Futures Act.
Whether penalties for false or misleading statements will be increased.
Whether the Equity Market Implementation Committee will report publicly on progress.
Whether the measures will affect ordinary retail investors' costs or choices.
